sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Sandbach arrive in exceptional form, unbeaten in their last five matches (W-D-W-W-W), and face a struggling Alsager side currently bottom of the league with just 4 points from 10 games. This should be a straightforward opportunity for the leaders to extend their advantage.
divisionWide: The title race remains competitive with second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) hosting third-placed AFC Bridgnorth's visitor Allscott Heath in Dawley Town v Stafford Town at 15:00. AFC Bridgnorth will look to maintain their strong form (6 wins in 8 games) when visiting Eccleshall, who sit fifth and are looking to bounce back. Wolverhampton Casuals, occupying fourth place with 19 points, travel to Wednesfield Community in a clash between mid-table sides. In-form Bilston Town (5 wins in their last 6) host Foley Meir, while Barnton entertain Shawbury United in a match between mid-table teams. Market Drayton Town face New Mills, Brereton Social host struggling Widnes Town (pointless in their last two outings), Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a basement battle, and Crewe play Allscott Heath—all fixtures scheduled for Saturday 15:00.
